column_description: A CHAR(12) primary key for each technical info record (e.g., 'TI1234567890').
An INET column storing the registration IP (e.g., '192.168.0.10').
A SMALLINT tracking how many countries this IP is linked to (e.g., '1').
A NUMERIC(7,4) fraction indicating VPN usage frequency (e.g., '0.3456').
A SMALLINT counting times a proxy was detected (e.g., '2').
A SMALLINT total number of devices (e.g., '3').
A NUMERIC(5,3) measure of browser diversity (e.g., '1.230').
